params.prompt: Create ONE standalone full-frame 16:9 game environment concept still for the existing VESPER Unity game. This is one image, NOT a collage, triptych, contact sheet, or split panel. Keep the high oblique top-down/isometric gameplay camera and the practical believable stylized-realistic 3D game rendering of the supplied screenshots. No cinematic horizon shot, no change to first-person, no large hero portrait. Keep the same single small dark-haired adventurer, muted teal shoulder cape, pale sleeves, dark trousers and boots, at the reference character scale near the center. Keep one continuous straight walkable path, clearly legible from the foreground through the background, with organic soft road edges and natural soil/stone transitions. Remove the UI labels and instruction text; no writing, titles, logos, borders or watermarks. Preserve grounded geometry and achievable real-time game detail. Scene 1: a NEW forest segment added before the existing rainy ruins. Reference image 1 gives the forest, path, character and camera language. Reference image 2 is the STRICT BASELINE for darkness and exposure. Match that existing rainy-abbey screenshot's base brightness; do not make this scene darker. This is the tense moment BEFORE rain begins: NO falling rain, no lightning, no rain splash rings, no puddle-covered road. Design a distinct wind-swept grove along the same straight route: clustered birches and dark oaks, a few wind-bent high branches and scattered airborne dry leaves, worn earthy track with sparse embedded weathered stones, mossy boulders and subdued undergrowth. The forest feels covered by heavy approaching storm clouds through broad soft cloud shadow and muted gray-green ambient light, with a thin low haze between the trunks. There is no need to expose a sky in this downward-facing camera. Preserve useful readable ground texture and the adventurer silhouette. A fresh believable adjacent section, consistent with the existing world, not merely a rain removal edit of the original frame. Show restrained environmental tension and depth without sunlight beams or pitch-black shadows.

Keep the environment's BASE ambient brightness at the reference level. Visible wind-slanted fine rain streaks, small natural ground splashes, shallow wet reflections integrated with muddy seams. No flames, explosions, road impact crater, glowing magic, or huge new buildings. This is a visual thunder cue made from lightning and its physically coherent illumination.

Reference image 2 is the STRICT brightness/exposure anchor: the new snow-night scene must remain approximately as readable and as dark as that existing rainy abbey, NOT darker. Replace sunny white snow with muted slate-blue and gray snow lit by soft cold cloud-filtered night ambient light, preserving readable midtones and the dark adventurer outline. Show a clearly strong side-blowing snowstorm with layered small diagonal snow streaks, a few larger soft nearby flakes, drifting ribbons of fine spindrift sliding close to the ground, and wind-tugged fir branches. A rolling gust crosses the rear of the path, while the foreground and center walking route stay clearly legible. Atmosphere comes from cold hue, obscured distance and visibly driven snow rather than crushing the exposure.

scope: Three separate concept images only; no Unity edits or imports.
